answer: Proof-of-Contention Auction.** Each identity must win a slot by submitting a unique, verifiable compute task whose solution is checked by peers; a random subset is recomputed, so faking identity means paying real electricity for every fake. Slots decay like a nebula dispersing unless renewed with fresh work. During a registration gale, new entries queue on a narrow ledge: only identities with sustained low-latency task completions advance. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake count in joules and wall-clock time, not tokens.
